name: Sichuan Golden Summit (group) Joint-Stock Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Golden Summit (group) Joint-Stock Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the mining, processing, and sale of limestone within China. Beyond this, the company manufactures and distributes calcium carbonate composite materials, and also supplies a range of building materials. Established in 1992, Sichuan Golden Summit is headquartered in Leshan, China.
